content_record.title: Ribonucleotide misincorporation into mtDNA triggers inflammation and senescence
content_record.editorial_body: Nucleotide imbalance drives age-related inflammation by destabilizing mitochondrial DNA, activating cGAS-STING and SASP. Nucleotide imbalance increases ribonucleotide misincorporation into mtDNA. This triggers mtDNA release, cGAS-STING activation, and SASP. Adding deoxyribonucleosides suppresses the inflammatory response. This signal is based on Ribonucleotide incorporation into mitochondrial DNA drives inflammation. from PubMed. Read the original report for full context.
